subject: Mythology
title: Afrofuturism: Ancient Myths Meet Tomorrow
description: A short lesson to help you apply Afrofuturism: Ancient Myths Meet Tomorrow.

hook.text: Afrofuturism blends African mythology with science fiction, imagining futures where ancient gods meet technology.

buildup.text: Writers like Octavia Butler and Nnedi Okofor weave Igbo and Yoruba myths into stories set in space and virtual worlds.

discovery.text: The genre argues that African mythology is not backward — it is a blueprint for imagining radically different futures.

twist.text: Sun Ra claimed he was from Saturn and performed jazz rituals — blending Egyptian myth with cosmic identity in the 1950s.

climax.text: Black Panther brought Afrofuturism to billions. Wakanda's technology is inseparable from its ancestral mythology.

punchline.text: Africa's oldest stories are now building its newest futures.

quiz.question: What does Afrofuturism combine?
options: European fairy tales with African art styles
African mythology with science fiction and futuristic visions
Asian martial arts traditions with African dance
